messages:
Alex K: Quick async — where are we on SOC2 milestone M3 for KMS/HSM evidence? Need owners for 'rotation proof' & 'auditlog ingest smoke' by EOD Thu. @Sam R?
Maria O: I can take rotation proof if folks agree. Need exact artifact format. Is signed envelope + commit hash OK?
Sam R: SGTM but need to know who wires up audit logs into evidence pipeline. @Chris I?
Chris I: I can own auditlog ingest smoke. Blocking: staging HSM logs delayed until tomorrow. Will run ingest once available.
Jen C: For rotation proof we require rotation runbook + key-rotation audit log extract (last 90 days). Prefer CSV with fields: timestamp, key_id, operator, action, hash.
Alex K: Thanks. Maria — can you produce runbook + sample CSV? Also tie to ticket ENGSEC-4578.
Maria O: I'll drop a draft runbook in the doc & attach sample CSV by EOD. @Jen C can you confirm CSV schema matches auditor expectation?
Jen C: Confirmed. CSV schema ok. Use RFC3339 timestamps in header row. Also include S3 path and retention policy reference.
Chris I: Note for ingest: pipeline expects gzipped newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with fields {ts,key,action,actor,meta}. I'll convert CSV -> NDJSON using a quick script.
Sam R: Can you paste the script?
Chris I: ```
# csv2ndjson.sh
python -c "import csv,json,sys
for r in csv.DictReader(sys.stdin):
  print(json.dumps({'ts':r['timestamp'],'key':r['key_id'],'action':r['action'],'actor':r['operator'],'meta':{'hash':r.get('hash')}}))"
```
Alex K: Perfect. Once Maria uploads, Chris can run ingest and post smoke logs. @deploy-bot can you schedule a staging attach for 20:00 UTC?
deploy-bot: scheduled staging attachment for 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z :white_check_mark: 
Maria O: Uploaded draft runbook here: https://docs.redwood/internal/kms-rotation-runbook-draft. Sample CSV uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-evidence/kms/rotation/sample.csv
Chris I: Kicked off conversion and ingest. First smoke shows 42 events, no parse errors. Pushed to evidence-staging bucket.
Sam R: I'll validate sample against audit checklist and confirm pass/fail. ETA ~4h.
Jen C: If pass, we mark ENGSEC-4578 ready for evidence bundle. :thumbsup: 
Alex K: Thanks all. Quick follow-ups: Maria to own runbook finalization; Chris to own ingest validation & proof artifact; Sam to validate & produce summary note; Jen to sign off schema. Update the ticket accordingly.
Maria O: Ack. I'll finalize by 17:00 PT.
Chris I: I'll add a minimal smoke-run README in the bucket.
Sam R: If anything fails, ping #eng-oncall.
Alex K: Closing note — add link to HSM attestation doc in evidence bundle: https://docs.redwood/internal/hsm-attestation-v2
